sections.appearance: Kazusa has black hair with magenta hair on the inner side. She has what appears to be cat ears that follow the same coloring as her hair. Her eyes are red. Halo ==== Her halo is a purple snake eye, surrounded by a ring with a thin spike, followed by another ring. Uniform ==== She wears a standard short skirt uniform. It's white with a navy line across the bottom, and a neck, plus a Trinity logo, also being navy. On top of this, she wears a black hoodie, with white lines along the sleeves, and white accents on the pocket opennings. Her dress is tied in a pink bow over her hoodie. She has a simple black choker around her neck. She wears brown tights, and cyan shoes with black soles, and heels, white toe caps, collars, and midsoles, and red laces Firearm ==== She uses a black Bren L4A4 Gun with a pink stock, grip, and carrying handle. The Trinity emblem is imprinted on the receiver.

sections.personality: Kazusa is shown to be an easygoing individual. She cares deeply for her friends and is very aware of how she portrays herself while being out in public. It is later revealed in A Tale of After-School Sweets that she was a former gang member who was highly revered through the name of Cath Palug. After coincidentally seeing a girl living her life as a normal school girl, Kazusa chose to abandon her ways of a delinquent. She wishes to not bring up her past as she found it embarrassing and believed it to be foolish part of her childhood.
